## Current roles

- Since 2024: in charge of artificial intelligence developments for the GANIL accelerator division.
- Since 2023: in charge of collective effects studies for the [FCC-ee](https://home.cern/science/accelerators/future-circular-collider) high energy booster.
- Since 2022: scientific coordinator of M4CAST, the French network on AI for accelerators.
- Scientific coordinator of InM4CAST (ANR MRSEI/AMORCE) and MLAcc (CNRS master project on AI for accelerators).
- [ARTIFACT](https://artifact-network.org) network.
